abstract.para: &hawk;'s History Explorer allows you to create detailed cluster reports and view transition information. It provides the following options:

listitem.para: Create a cluster report for a certain time. &hawk; calls the crm report command to generate the report.
Allows you to upload crm report archives that have either been created with the &crmshell; directly or even on a different cluster.

topic.para: After reports have been generated or uploaded, they are shown below Reports. From the list of reports, you can show a report's details, or download or delete the report.

procedure.title: Generating or uploading a cluster report

step.para: In a Web browser, go to https://HAWKSERVER:7630/ and log in.
From the left navigation bar, select TroubleshootingHistory.
The History Explorer screen opens in the Generate view. By default, the suggested time frame for a report is the last hour.
To immediately start a report, click Generate.

To modify the time frame for the report, click anywhere on the suggested time frame and select another option from the drop-down box. You can also enter a Custom start date, end date and hour, respectively. To start the report, click Generate.
After the report has finished, it is shown below Reports.
To upload a cluster report, the crm report archive must be located on a file system that you can access with &hawk;. Proceed as follows:
Browse for the cluster report archive and click Upload.
After the report is uploaded, it is shown below Reports.
To download or delete a report, click the respective icon next to the report in the Operations column.
To view , click the report's name or select Show from the Operations column.
Return to the list of reports by clicking the Reports button.

listitem.para: Number of transitions plus time line of all transitions in the cluster that are covered by the report.

topic.para: For each transition, the cluster saves a copy of the state which it provides as input to pacemaker-schedulerd. The path to this archive is logged. All pe-* files are generated on the Designated Coordinator (DC). As the DC can change in a cluster, there may be pe-* files from several nodes. Any pe-* files are saved snapshots of the CIB, used as input of calculations by pacemaker-schedulerd.
In &hawk;, you can display the name of each pe-* file plus the time and node on which it was created. The History Explorer can also visualize the following details, based on the respective pe-* file:
